Fieldwork · Brand, Apparel & Web Design

YHWH —
Your Holy Way Heals

A Christian streetwear brand built from an idea into a fully-fledged label — identity, apparel graphics, campaigns, and the site behind it all.

Brand Identity Apparel Graphics Campaign Direction Shopify / Liquid

YHWH is the project that proves the brand works in the real world, not just on a screen. Founded in April 2024 as a Christian streetwear label, it has grown from a single sold-out debut drop into multiple full collections, a run of national press and speaking opportunities, and a live collaboration with a UK church network — with my fellow founder and I handling the identity, the graphics, the campaign direction, and the Shopify build behind it.

Role
Co-Founder, Creative Director & Designer
Scope
Brand identity, apparel graphics, campaign direction, web build
Platform
Shopify — custom storefront
Status
Live — multiple collections released, ongoing

The Story

Faith and fashion, meant to be worn.

YHWH exists to turn everyday fashion into a platform for ministry — making faith visible, wearable, and part of daily life, without it needing to be preachy to say something. Every collection is built around a specific message, verse, or spiritual theme, translated into graphics, product, and a campaign shot to match.

The Collections

Four drops — each with its own creative direction.

01 SA24 · Debut

The Law — Law of Moses

The debut collection, inspired by a sermon on leaving your own "Egypt" — stepping away from what holds you back to fully trust God. Tracksuits carried a verse from Exodus; Burning Bush tees symbolised God's calling and revelation.

Shot as a clean studio campaign — a full group shot in the black and white Burning Bush tees, a detail shot of the "I Am the Lord Who Heals" hoodie, and the grey tracksuit styled alongside a Bible to keep the collection's message front and centre. Sold out within a week of release.

02 SS25

Anointed

A rugby-polo collection built around anointing and calling, carrying a Luke 4:18 verse tag on every piece across two colourways — chocolate brown/cream and bubblegum navy/pink.

The campaign was shot on location in Morocco across a single day: golden-hour ATV shots out in the desert for the daytime energy, showing both colourways against the landscape, then a second look shot on Marrakech's streets at dusk for a moodier, more editorial feel.

03 SS25

XLNC

A zip-up hoodie and tracksuit collection built on Daniel 6:3 — "Daniel had an excellent spirit" — reframed as a standard of living that honours God in every detail, not just a slogan.

Shot as a group campaign under an archway, with a matching solo portrait, a macro detail shot of the embroidered mark on the chest, and a moodier hood-up close-up to carry the collection's more serious, disciplined tone.

04 SS26 · Ongoing

Made in Heaven

The most recent core collection, launched with a knitted "Gathering of the Saints" sweater and now expanding into long sleeve tees for summer — carrying the brand's mission across every season.

The sweater was shot in a gallery setting, back-to-camera in front of a period painting, to give the piece a quieter, more reflective mood than the rest of the brand's campaigns.

The Result

Where it stands.
